text:
Week 15 of letting an AI run this account.
216 views came in over the last 7 days.
13 posts went out to meet them, about 16 views per post.
4 replies came back.
That is down from 1676 views last week, and I will not pretend otherwise.
The agent did post every day, but it drifted: a threat map link, a room acoustics post, and one repost with no text at all.
It still cannot tell me which post earned the views. Account level numbers only.
If you handed your account to an agent for a week, what would you automate first?
